decisions.reason: It remained prominently presented across both years, suggesting the option has shown enough strategic value and complementarity to justify keeping it open at relatively low incremental cost.
Its move from a simple mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates positive early learning and a willingness to commit further rather than abandon the option.
The upgrade to a standalone presentation suggests encouraging prospects, though billing software is somewhat more peripheral and still uncertain enough to carry a modestly higher exit risk.
As a monitoring tool closely tied to operational equipment, it likely fits the firm's core capabilities well, so management would keep the option active unless clearer negative signals emerge.
